why_a_recipe_must_also_be_registered: The frozen arm protocol says the trained arm is a delivery-specific component trained only on the TRAIN split, but it does NOT name a training objective. Since the objective determines which candidate gets frozen for the development gate, registering it after seeing any training result would be the same error as registering a dataset after seeing it.

component.frozen_part: the pretrained CVRP encoder and decoder, bit-identical throughout (verified by parameter hash in the smoke run)
component.trainable_part: bilinear edge head over frozen node features: Z = linear2(relu(linear1(H))), logits = Z Z^T / sqrt(hidden)
component.why_bilinear: it consumes the same node features the zero-shot decoder consumes, so the comparison isolates WHAT SCORES the insertion, not what encodes the instance
component.resource_matching: the guide's logits() still pays one frozen decoder call and discards it, so actual decoder calls stay matched across all four registered arms

training_objective.name: advantage_weighted_decision_ranking (policy improvement by weighted imitation)
training_objective.rationale: the registered gate is about the CONTRACT COST of the reconstruction, so the training signal must come from realized cost, not from distance or from the zero-shot model's preferences
training_objective.per_step_target: at every recorded insertion step of a certified cycle, the chosen option (customer, vehicle, position) is the target among the legal options that the frozen reconstruct enumerates at that same state
training_objective.weighting: each cycle contributes with weight sign(delta_cost) * |delta_cost| normalised over the TRAIN split, so decisions observed in cost-reducing cycles are reinforced and decisions observed in cost-increasing cycles are suppressed
training_objective.loss: weighted softmax cross-entropy of the head-induced option scores toward the recorded option
training_objective.head_inputs_at_train_time: the head is applied directly to the frozen features; the discarded decoder call is a PANEL resource-matching device and is NOT performed during training

mandatory_fidelity_gate_before_any_optim.requirement: the option enumeration used by the trainer must reproduce the frozen reconstruct's own recorded decisions EXACTLY on every certified TRAIN cycle - same customer, same vehicle, same position, in the same order
mandatory_fidelity_gate_before_any_optim.why: the trainer necessarily re-enumerates the legal options that the frozen reconstruct enumerates internally; if the re-enumeration diverges, the trainer is optimising a different operator than the one that will be deployed, and the whole arm becomes uninterpretable
mandatory_fidelity_gate_before_any_optim.action_on_failure: abort the run, record the mismatch with the cycle index and step, and change nothing else; never lower the requirement to make the run proceed

amendment_1.reason: replaying the FULL rule (every remaining candidate customer plus the regret and tie-break rule) at every step of all 505 certified cycles was measured to be far slower than the remainder of the run and was not practical on a single CPU thread
amendment_1.what_is_still_checked_on_every_selected_: per-customer option fidelity - the vehicle/position option set and its ordering, for the customer the frozen reconstruction actually chose
amendment_1.what_is_checked_on_a_bounded_subset: full-rule fidelity, including the customer selection, on a registered number of cycles for a registered number of steps each
amendment_1.requirement_unchanged: match rate on whatever is checked must still be exactly 1.0, and the checked scope is reported explicitly in the run artifact so a reader can see the depth actually verified
amendment_1.not_a_relaxation_after_a_result: this changes verification DEPTH, was decided from measured cost before any training result existed, and is recorded here rather than applied silently

registered_training_settings.epochs: to be fixed in the run registration before the run
registered_training_settings.selection: no hyperparameter search: exactly one configuration is trained, and the development gate either passes or does not

gates.development: the frozen trained arm must beat regret2_nolearn on DEV with mean relative full-cost reduction >= 1 percent and a paired instance-level CI lower bound > 0, and it must also be compared against zeroshot_guide and discard_control at matched decoder calls
gates.program_main_gate_restated: the delivery MAIN gate additionally requires the same >= 1 percent with CI lower bound > 0 against EACH registered random/nonlearned control AND a qualified strong rolling controller, at identical online information, legal actions and total budget
gates.confirm: a separate protocol: three fresh 40-complete-day cohorts, alpha_total = 0.05/(j(j+1)) split across pickup/delivery and Bonferroni across contrasts and cohorts
gates.no_equivalence_claim: a CI spanning zero means the difference is not established, never equivalence

explicit_non_claims.note: a negative result here closes only this recipe at this configuration; it cannot show that no trained component or operator could help, and it must not be reported as such

known_evidence_that_makes_a_positive_res: the zero-shot guide was worse than a random same-architecture model in every role tested in this cycle
the earlier destroy-role panel found -4.84 percent against the discard control with a CI spanning zero
the pickup line's reuse of the same zero-shot guide also produced negative point estimates at two subproblem sizes
